column1: 12 stories. Full detail of each story is in the Markdown file and the story files.

column4: Recovery module folder and boundary test
column5: As a squad member (RW-TRIBE), I want the recovery module folder and packages in the ACE repository with a build-time boundary test, so that no module calls the inside of another module, no recovery code calls a system of record directly, and no recovery code reads an ACE table except through a recovery.v_ace_* view.

column4: Code owners for the recovery module
column5: As a squad member (RW-TRIBE), I want a code owners entry that maps every recovery folder to the TechX tech leads and the common module to the ACE team, with review by a code owner required before merge, so that every change in the recovery module is reviewed by its owners.

column4: Types and contract tests from the API specification
column5: As a squad member (RW-TRIBE), I want server interfaces and front end types generated from the OpenAPI file, with a contract test and an access test per endpoint, so that the front end and the service never drift from the specification and no endpoint skips its access check.

column4: Masked data in SIT and UAT
column5: As a Tribe lead and squad member (RW-TRIBE), I want SIT and UAT to run on ACE data whose personal fields are masked in the recovery.v_ace_* views and by role at the API, so that tests run on realistic volumes without exposing customers.
column9: v_ace_account, v_ace_payment, v_ace_customer, v_ace_contact, recovery_case, case_party, interaction, sys_fields

column4: Outbox and retry for outbound work
column5: As a squad member (RW-TRIBE), I want every application event and every outbound work request written to an outbox in the same transaction as the change, and delivered to each consumer in order with retry, so that no outbound action is lost when a system or a consumer is down, and nothing is sent for a change that did not commit.

As a platform administrator (RW-PLATADM), I want the timer check, the morning allocation run and the daily reconciliation run as Quartz jobs with a run book each, so that scheduled work runs once, on time and visibly, and a missed run is caught up for its business date.

As an internal auditor (RW-AUDIT), I want a nightly job that recomputes the whole decision log hash chain, records the result with the last hash, and reports a break to Compliance the same day, so that a changed entry is found the day it happens and the log can be relied on in audit.

As a squad member (RW-TRIBE), I want a load test at the busiest-hour volume, run in SIT before each release, that fails the release stage when a screen request is too slow, so that response targets are proven before users feel them.

As a squad member (RW-TRIBE), I want browser tests and an accessibility scan on the main recovery screens, on the browsers the bank supports and in Thai and English, in every pipeline run, so that screens work for every user on the bank's browsers.

column4: PDPA lint for code, tests and logs
column5: As a squad member (RW-TRIBE), I want a pipeline check that finds personal data in code, test fixtures, log statements and error messages, built from the data dictionary's list of personal fields, so that personal data never leaks into code or logs.
As a platform administrator, I want blob containers for documents, with a write-once container for legal types, reached by managed identity, so that legal documents cannot be overwritten.

As a platform administrator (RW-PLATADM), I want one client in the recovery module that calls the agent orchestrator, applies the autonomy mode, runs shadow mode and falls back to the rule result, so that agents are added to a case step without changing the case flow, and every step records what the agent did.
